name: Castaway Cay Serenity Bay Adult BBQ Flame-Grilled Ribeye Steak
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Castaway Cay · Serenity Bay BBQ (Adults 18+)
whyItWorks: Exclusive to the 18+ Serenity Bay beach tram stop on Castaway Cay: freshly grilled-to-order ribeye steak paired with plain steamed jasmine rice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the grill chef for a freshly cooked ribeye steak with light salt only (no heavy black pepper), trim visible edge fat, and pair with steamed jasmine rice and banana bread.
watchOuts: Coarse grill pepper if not requested light
